rubrics.text: on falling asleep while lying on either side
foreign substances drop into larynx when drinking or talking
alternating with contraction of fingers and toes
seems to move about in larynx
as if food passed over sore spot
extending to root of tongue and into hyoid bone
short hacking cough and loss of voice
going into open air from warm room
